title: Classic Moroccan Fava Bean Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew originating from Morocco, made with tender fava beans, rich flavors and spices. Serve warm, garnished with chopped herbs and a dollop of yogurt.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the cumin and paprika, stirring to combine.
Add the bissara and fava beans, stirring to combine.
Add the with and kissed, stirring to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the beans are tender.
Stir in the crumbled cheese until melted and well combined.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve warm, garnished with chopped herbs and a dollop of yogurt.
